latin: Per praecedentem conclusionem potest intelligens in arithmetica formali intelligere quod operari per scemamphoras est proprium rationalis naturae.
translation: Through the preceding conclusion, one who understands formal arithmetic can understand that to operate through scemamphoras is proper to rational nature.
